newsitem.title: FRANCE: French parliament to debate Europe policy Nov 27.
newsitem.headline: French parliament to debate Europe policy Nov 27.

text.p: The French parliament will hold a debate on its European policy on November 27, parliamentary sources said on Tuesday.
The government will make a statement on its European policy, followed by a debate. There will be no vote.
The debate precedes a meeting of European Union finance ministers in Brussels on December 2 in preparation for the EU summit of heads of state and government in Dublin on December 13 and 14.

The French government is under fire for its pursuit of strict fiscal policies, designed to help France meet in 1997 the Maastricht criteria for a single currency, which some critics blame for the record level of unemployment in France.
A Gallup poll published on November 13 put Prime Minister Alain Juppe's popularity among French voters at a record low.
